extensionDescription.message: Connects ChatGPT in the browser to the Arara Code chat and lets the IDE AI use your own browser tabs.

headline.message: Link your browser to Arara Code

intro.message: The Arara Code AI works in your tabs, and ChatGPT becomes a chat in the IDE.

instructions.message: Copy the code in Arara settings › Arara Browser and paste it here.

permissions.message: Keep the browser open while the AI works.

updateInstructions.message: To update, click Update in Arara settings › Arara Browser.

invalidCodeIde.message: Invalid code. Copy it again in Arara Code.

ready.message: Connected. Go back to Arara Code.

openIde.message: Open Arara Code and copy the code again.

updateFailed.message: Version $1 · Could not check. Reopen to try again.

disconnectedByIde.message: Disconnected by the IDE. Copy the current code.

busy.message: The browser is still handling another request.

noResponse.message: The extension did not respond in this tab. Reload the extension and the ChatGPT tab.

tabFailed.message: Could not open the ChatGPT tab.

stopFirst.message: Stop the current request before changing the connection.

reloaded.message: The page reloaded after delivery. No message was resent; check the conversation in the browser.

tabClosed.message: The ChatGPT tab closed before confirmation. No message was resent.

notReady.message: ChatGPT is not ready. Check your sign-in and the page in the browser.

modelUnavailable.message: Model unavailable in this conversation. Refresh the models.

unconfirmed.message: Could not confirm the end of the response. No action was taken.

agentIntro.message: To use it, type @ in the chat and choose Your browser.

sitesAllowed.message: The AI can now use your tabs.

sitesDenied.message: Site access was not granted. The AI cannot use your tabs.

agentWorking.message: Arara AI is using this browser

outdatedBody.message: You have version $1 and version $2 is out. Until you update, the AI and ChatGPT can't use this browser.

outdatedEasy.message: Easiest way: in Arara Code, open Settings › Arara Browser and click Update. The extension restarts by itself.

outdatedManual.message: Or do it by hand: download the package, unzip it on top of the extension folder (replace the files) and click Reload on the extensions page.

outdatedManualFirefox.message: Firefox: download the new file, open about:debugging, go to This Firefox, click Load Temporary Add-on and choose it.

outdatedRefusal.message: Arara Browser is outdated (version $1, latest $2). Ask the user to update it in Arara Code: Settings › Arara Browser › Update.
